input: A state with exactly two fields, title and abstract. The abstract is truncated to its first 100 words. No category, licence, author, date or identifier may be present.
name: laya-arxiv-topic-router

criteria.cond-mat.mes-hall: Condensed matter: mesoscopic transport, Hall and magnetotransport, quantum dots.
criteria.cond-mat.mtrl-sci: Condensed matter materials: surfaces, thin films, nanostructures, growth.
criteria.gr-qc: General relativity and quantum cosmology: gravity, black holes, spacetime.
criteria.hep-ph: High energy phenomenology: colliders, the Standard Model, neutrino experiments.
criteria.hep-th: High energy theory: field theory, strings, supersymmetry, quantum gravity.
criteria.math.AG: Mathematics: algebraic and differential geometry, topology, algebra.
criteria.quant-ph: Quantum physics: quantum information, computing, optics, open systems.

question.instructions: Route the preprint to its primary arXiv subject area. Judge the title and abstract only, and choose exactly one area.

task: Eight-way arXiv subject-area routing from title and truncated abstract.
usage_note: The criteria descriptions are load-bearing. A caller that replaces them with bare category codes, as an earlier version of the model card did, gets materially worse answers from the same weights.
